name: Amor de otro universo
source:
A visual novel about love, it tells the story of a young woman who has the ability to teleport to another universe at will. One day, she decides to venture out and makes a great friend. There, she decides to study and work, returning to her world at night.

She falls in love with a boy, but he breaks her heart, only to meet someone else who ends up doing the same to her. Time passes, and it helps her overcome her pain and think more optimistically.

Who will you choose to stay with?

[Translated from [url=https://seityposa.itch.io/amor-de-otro-universo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部关于爱情的视觉小说，讲述了一个拥有随意传送到另一个宇宙能力的年轻女子的故事。有一天，她决定出去冒险，并结识了一位好朋友。在那里，她决定学习和工作，晚上回到自己的世界。

她爱上了一个男孩，但他伤了她的心，却遇到了另一个最终对她做同样事情的人。时间流逝，帮助她克服痛苦并更加乐观地思考。

你会选择和谁住在一起？

[译自[url=https://seityposa.itch.io/amor-de-otro-universo]Itch.io[/url]]
